title: Bind the guard to the pause coordination hash and execute the paired BC refit
summary: A successor lead continues the authorized Stage 2 goal under an approved plan. The maintained reservation guard binds the pause coordination hash c89c99eb... with a CPU test. The prepared onset-loss BC refit helper moved into experiments/paper_walk under protocol 002 and ran on CPU: the onset-weighted arm reduces first-moving-onset target RMSE from 0.026681 to 0.001857 rad against 0.008535 rad for the uniform arm, with steady-row RMSE 0.001653 versus 0.001262 rad. Both candidates are fitting results only. The Spark host was unreachable from the executing machine, so the host ownership recheck, source_020 freeze and native candidate evaluation remain pending. The release manifest advances to canonical-restart v7.
next: Recheck live ownership, resources and both GPU locks on the Spark host, freeze source_020 with fresh bindings, evaluate both refit candidates with the cold and settled startup arms, then implement the tripod reference plus residual controller.
